questions.question: Summarize the discussion about detailed design of the remote control.
questions.reference_answer: There were two main parts in the detailed design. Firstly, the prototype presentation, Industrial Designer presented the design on the wheel, the button, and the base of the remote control. Secondly, Marketing presented eleven points to be evaluated based on the findings in marketing trend reports and company strategy marketing. Besides, the group had a point calculation on each evaluation criterion.

turn_packed__dense__w512.answer: The team discussed the detailed design of a remote control featuring a wheel for changing channels or volume, a power button that also functions as a menu trigger, and an interchangeable base with a squishy, spongy rubbery feel. The base can be customized with different colored "trendy" fruit designs (e.g., mango, strawberry) that users can swap out. The remote includes a chip for functionality and a beeper. Challenges included ensuring the remote was hand-holdable and fitting the battery case within the design.
